description: Insert a picture from an image blob on a slide, or replace a picture's image (target), keeping its frame, height or width. An SVG stays vector, with a PNG fallback made for it; ppt_set_shape fill and line recolour it. Returns its address and native size.

anchor.description: Replacing: the point that stays put. Default top_left.

box.description: Default: native size at the content area's top left.

keep.description: Replacing: what of the frame stays. Default frame.

key.description: Retry key: a repeat with the same key makes nothing new.

slide.description: Slide to insert on, s:256 or $ref.

target.description: Or the picture to replace or placeholder to fill.

name: ppt_add_picture
